verdict.rationale: Airweave gives only a single rough latency figure (~0.5sec for direct vector search) with no methodology, percentile breakdown, or measured benchmarks; no p50/p95 data or SLA-style targets exist anywhere in docs. Missing for 10: p50/p95 or other percentile latency benchmarks, documented measurement methodology, hardware/scale conditions, and independent/community verification of the speed claim.
